verdict.rationale: Copilot documents connecting MCP servers to Copilot Chat "to share context from other applications" and building custom MCP servers for specific needs. Marketing also says it works in "project tools, chat apps, and custom MCP servers," and admins can allow-list MCP servers. That gives a generic path to external workflow tools. However, nothing in the evidence names Jira, Slack or Google Drive connectors, so reaching those tools appears to depend on finding or building suitable MCP servers. Missing for 10: documented first-party or ready-made connectors for Jira, Slack and Google Drive, clarity on whether the cloud agent (not just IDE chat) can use these integrations, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
